svg.title: Sheet 2 of 2 - Control and sensors
svg.desc: Arduino Uno or Nano wired to an nRF24L01+ radio, an HX710B pressure sensor, a DHT22, an NPK soil sensor through a MAX485 RS485 module, and one L298N driving four BO motors as two parallel pairs.
svg.text: Rover electronics · Sheet 2 of 2 · rev A · 2026-10-03
Arduino Uno / Nano · nRF24L01+ · HX710B pressure · DHT22 · NPK soil sensor (RS485) · L298N + 4 BO motors

svg.text: VS > 12 V when the pack is full → logic 5 V comes from the buck, not the module
1. nRF24L01+ VCC is 3.3 V only (5 V destroys it). Its I/O pins tolerate 5 V, so the Arduino talks to it directly.
2. HX710B: keep SCK high for less than 60 µs between pulses, or the chip powers itself down.
3. RS485: no reply from the NPK sensor? Swap A and B. Check the sensor's baud rate and address.
4. Swap a motor's two wires if it turns backwards. On a full pack keep PWM near 55 % for 6 V BO motors.
5. Upload code with the master switch OFF (USB powers the board); never feed the 5V pin and USB together.
6. NPK sensors want 9–24 V (some 10–30 V). A flat 3S pack sags to ≈ 9–10 V: check your sensor's minimum or add a 12 V boost module.
